description:
A False Colour Infrared (FCIR) satellite image displays a landscape featuring a prominent river, dense vegetation, and a classified road network. The image is oriented with the river flowing roughly from north to south. The main features are:
*   A dark, winding river runs through the right side of the image.
*   Extensive areas of dark red indicate dense, healthy vegetation, likely forests, particularly visible on both sides of the river and to the west of the road.
*   Lighter pinkish-red rectangular shapes within the vegetated areas suggest agricultural fields or areas with sparser vegetation.
*   A distinct light blue line, representing a "Road network and its associated land", runs parallel to the river on its western side. This road network is defined with a minimum mapping width of 10 metres.
*   A dark, elongated, oval-shaped feature on the far-left appears to be a lake or pond.
*   Scattered small white/grey points along the road and river suggest human settlements or individual buildings.
No scale bar, compass, legend, or specific geographic location is visible in the image.
